name: Nuli Wuyu: Mei Mo
source:
Slave Story/Succubus is a little story about Yoyo. Yoyo is a top student of the Succubus Academy, her graduation project is to invade the human world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/736520/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《奴隶故事/魅魔》是一个关于悠悠的小故事。Yoyo是魅魔学院的高材生，她的毕业计划是入侵人类世界。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/736520/]Steam[/url]]
